name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1503: Konyo asked for four visual states app-wide with no fifth kinda-ok purple. The engine bay already had four classes but seven state-ish hexes had accumulated underneath them, so the same meaning wore different colours depending on which surface drew it. The four are now tokens named for meaning - good, working, needs, broken - plus an idle token for the absence of state, and the engine organs and fleet dots draw from them. sim and info stay deliberately outside the set: one marks the past-simulation MODE and the other marks explanation, neither is a health. A gate keeps a fifth state from being invented by accident.
